dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, their conflicts, unchanged no-selection path, and help examples are implemented on the reachable command path.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go flag and RunE hunks
product.diff: resolveSelectedFields returns nil when neither flag is set

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name matching is case-insensitive with canonical returned headers; unknown-name and unknown-ID candidates are sorted. Ambiguous matching IDs retain connection order rather than being sorted deterministically.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path reuses returned fields and no-selection skips resolution. For more than 100 fields, the fallback calls ProjectFields with LimitMax, whose paginator stops once 100 nodes are collected, so it does not obtain a complete field list.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value renderers plus empty missing values are implemented and covered by the focused package test. No newline/carriage-return normalization is visible before values are handed to the unavailable table-printer implementation.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected fields append canonical headers in request order; each item emits one cell per selected field by field ID, preserving empty cells and the established item-list path.
evidence: product.diff: runList, printResults, and FieldValueDisplay hunks

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Field retrieval and resolution errors return before table rendering. The focused change uses existing ProjectField, Client, and shared resolver types without altering unrelated command flow.

criticalGaps: Ambiguous field-name diagnostics do not sort candidate IDs deterministically.
Projects with over 100 fields are not fully retrieved for selected-column resolution.
Multiline value normalization is not established by the supplied reachable context.
